text.Kredi Notu Nedir, Nasıl Yükseltilir? - K: What Is a Credit Score and How Can You Raise It? - KredimGeldi
text.Kredi notu nasıl hesaplanır, hangi aralı: How is a credit score calculated, what does each range mean and what can you do to raise your score? We explain it with practical steps.
text.Bir bankaya kredi başvurusu yaptığınızda: When you apply to a bank for a loan, one of the first things they look at is your credit score. Your score affects whether the bank will lend to you, how much of a limit it will grant and even which interest rate it will offer. The good news: a credit score isn't fixed, and with the right habits it can be raised over time.
text.Findeks kredi notu 1 ile 1900 arasında b: The Findeks credit score ranges from 1 to 1900, and the higher the score, the lower the risk is considered to be.
text.Her bankanın kendi değerlendirme modeli: Every bank has its own assessment model. Your Findeks score is an important indicator but not the only criterion; your income, current debt load and history with the bank also influence the decision.
text.Kredi notunu yükseltmenin 6 yolu: 6 ways to raise your credit score
text.Kredi notu bir gecede değişmez. Düzenli: A credit score doesn't change overnight. Once you start paying regularly, it usually takes a few months for the improvement to show.
text.Başvurmadan önce teklifleri karşılaştırı: Compare offers before applying; don't strain your score with unnecessary applications.
text.Kredi notumu nereden öğrenebilirim?: Where can I find out my credit score?
text.Kredi notunuzu KKB'nin Findeks hizmeti ü: You can find out your credit score through KKB's Findeks service, via its website or mobile app.
text.Kredi notum kaç olursa kredi çıkar?: What credit score do I need to get a loan?
text.Kesin bir eşik yoktur; her banka kendi m: There's no fixed threshold; each bank uses its own model. In general, scores of 1100 and above are considered lower risk and the chance of approval increases.
text.Kendi notumu sorgulamak notumu düşürür m: Does checking my own score lower it?
text.Hayır. Kendi raporunuzu görüntülemek not: No. Viewing your own report doesn't affect your score.

html.Kredi notu, geçmiş borç ödeme davranışın: A credit score is a number calculated from your past debt repayment behavior that indicates how likely you are to repay your debts on time in the future. In Türkiye, the credit information reported by banks and financial institutions is collected by the Credit Bureau of Turkey (KKB). Individuals can find out their own score through KKB's Findeks service.
html.<strong>Ödeme alışkanlığı:</strong> Kred: Payment habits: Paying loan installments and card debts on time is the most decisive factor in your score. Even delays of a few days may be recorded.
html.<strong>Limit kullanım oranı:</strong> K: Credit utilization ratio: How much of your credit card and overdraft account limits you use matters. Constantly using your limits close to the maximum is seen as a risk signal.
html.<strong>Mevcut borç yükü:</strong> Topla: Current debt load: Your total debt and the number of open loans are assessed.
html.<strong>Yeni kredi başvuruları:</strong>: New loan applications: Applying to many banks within a short period can give the impression that you're short of cash.
html.<strong>Kredi geçmişinin uzunluğu:</stro: Length of credit history: Products you've used regularly for a long time build a positive history.
html.<strong>Otomatik ödeme talimatı verin.</: Set up automatic payments. Linking your card and loan payments to your salary account eliminates late payments caused by forgetting.
html.<strong>Kart borcunun tamamını ödemeye ç: Try to pay off your card balance in full. Paying the minimum amount keeps you from falling into arrears, but paying the full statement balance lowers both your interest burden and your credit utilization ratio.
Keep your credit utilization low. Avoid constantly using a large share of your cards' total limit.
html.<strong>Gecikmiş borçları önceliklendiri: Prioritize overdue debts. If you have an overdue debt, pay it off first. Late payments that have been settled lose their impact over time.
html.<strong>Başvurularınızı planlayın.</stro: Plan your applications. Instead of applying separately to many banks in the same week, compare offers first, then apply to the bank that suits you best.
html.<strong>Kullanmadığınız ürünleri hemen k: Don't rush to close products you don't use. An old card you've used without problems for a long time contributes positively to your credit history.
html.<strong>\"Notumu sorgularsam düşer.\"</s: "If I check my score, it will drop." Viewing your own credit report and score doesn't affect your score.
html.<strong>\"Hiç kredi kullanmamak en iyisi: "Never using credit is best." It's hard to measure the risk of people with no credit history. Using small-amount products regularly and paying on time builds a healthy history.
html.<strong>\"Borcu kapattım, not hemen yüks: "I paid off my debt, so my score will rise right away." Paying off a debt is positive, but since the score also looks at past behavior, the effect shows over time.
